The auditor (Bigsix) needs a timeboxed window and a short statement confirming the data retention cutoff for artifacts in the portal (we need to show evidence provenance that files covering Oct 1–Dec 31, 2023 are retained).

- A bridge letter confirming SOC 2 Type II scope and any known non-contiguous coverage windows (if applicable)

Timing: auditor would like access starting Tue 30 Apr (US PST) if possible.

Thanks — please include a contact for tech access issues.

Best,

1) Confirming audit period: you list Q4 2023 (Oct 1–Dec 31, 2023) — is that the only period you need evidence for, or should we include the rolling 12-month snapshot (Jan 1–Dec 31, 2023)?
2) Which artifact types are needed for download access? (ex: control evidence PDFs, config exports, S3 logs CSVs, user access screenshots)

Proposed plan:
- Provide ephemeral SAML one‑time link scoped to the AcmePayments auditor group for a 48-hour window (we can reduce to view-only, but some auditors request download for hashing on their side)
- Attach an evidence manifest CSV so you can confirm artifact list before we open access
- Draft a concise bridge letter that confirms scope and date ranges, plus the retention cutoff statement.

I'm looping in Kimberley (controls owner) and Marissa (trust portal ops) to confirm retention and to sign the bridge. Rafael — can you confirm whether any evidence was rotated to cold storage after Dec 31, 2023 and whether hashes are available for S3 logs?

I attached a preliminary evidence_manifest_v1.csv with what we can confirm quickly. Will follow up once I have retention confirmation.

Regards,
